label: Upside
description: Strong exit market - multiples 10% higher, EBITDA growth 2 points higher, exits two quarters early.

label: Downside
description: Soft market - multiples 15% lower, EBITDA growth 3 points lower, exits one year late.

label: Severe downside
description: Recession - multiples 30% lower, growth 5 points lower, exits 18 months late, one more write-off.

label: Delayed exits
description: Same businesses and multiples, but every exit slips by 18 months.

label: Deal-by-deal waterfall
description: Base case under a deal-by-deal (American) waterfall with a 30% carry escrow.

label: Late losses, deal-by-deal
description: Deal-by-deal waterfall; early exits succeed, the later vintage fails - the GP clawback is triggered.

label: Late losses, whole-of-fund
description: The same outcomes under a whole-of-fund (European) waterfall - no carry is paid, so nothing to claw back.

label: LP-friendly terms
description: LP-friendly terms - 1.5% fee stepping down to 1.25%, 15% carry, no catch-up (hard hurdle).

label: GP-friendly terms
description: GP-friendly terms - 2% on commitments for the whole term, 50% fee offset, 25% carry over a 6% hurdle, deal-by-deal.

label: Subscription line
description: Base case with a subscription line that carries each capital call for two quarters at 6.5%.
